literal: He with a small army, suitable place if he reaches, he with a mighty army's spirit having been destroyed will be.
translation: If a leader with a small army reaches a suitable place for defense, the spirit of the leader with a mighty army will be shattered.
modern: சிறிய படையை உடையவன் தனக்குப் பொருத்தமான இடத்தை அடைந்து போரிட்டால், பெரிய படையை உடையவனின் ஊக்கம் அழிந்து போய்விடும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the strategic importance of choosing the right battleground. Even if a leader has only a small army, securing an advantageous position gives them a critical edge. Consequently, the morale and momentum of an opponent with a massive army will be completely broken, because their numerical superiority is neutralized by the terrain. The contrast between a small army and a mighty army emphasizes that location can overcome sheer numbers.
